title: BMS & Smart Building Lab

title: SCADA Monitoring & Control Lab
description: Build industrial visualization, alarm, trend, reporting and PLC communication skills in a realistic supervisory-control environment.

title: Siemens PLC, HMI & Drives Lab

title: Solar PV & Energy Lab
description: Learn solar PV design, system sizing, inverter configuration, and renewable energy grid integration.
